policy: Preserve the detailed core and all building, bridge and sewer elevations.
Model the shoreline of the union, not a bank around every source polygon; confluences and through-building passages stay open.
Leave source clipping boundaries open rather than constructing dams across the upstream river or the Thames context window.
Mills, gates and locks retain unassigned capacities, crests, sills and operating states.
Do not import concrete flood works or river alignments from the 1930s.
